arguments.about: Okay so, I'm Maya, 34, I live in Brooklyn but grew up in Atlanta. Best trip ever was Lisbon with my husband Dev and our daughter Anika who is 6 — we ate pastel de nata every morning and heard fado in Alfama. I like mid-range budget, slow pace, boutique hotels or a good Airbnb, and honestly I like meeting people at a bar. Food: I go out of my way for ramen, tacos and natural wine bars; I'm vegetarian. Music: I'm obsessed with Khruangbin and LCD Soundsystem, love funk, soul, indie, disco, I'd travel for Primavera Sound. I follow the Atlanta Hawks. Best moment: dancing until 4am at a rooftop in Mexico City with strangers who became friends. I fly out of JFK.
